status: Complete 2026-11-09: proved that a torus has a digon face exactly when its lattice holds (1,1) or (1,-1) (square) or a unit (honeycomb), never on the triangular lattice, and that then a factor of the walk polynomial vanishes so composition cannot reach everywhere, and that on odd square tori without digons the power 2^r - 1 of L is 1 off the symmetric difference of the diagonal subgroups; computed that at odd index 3 to 151 composition reaches everywhere exactly where there is no digon, except the honeycomb n x n with 3 not dividing n and one honeycomb torus of index 63, and that at even index (to 48) no rule by the lattice mod 16, the 2-part of the group or the mirrors decides it.
